name: roles/splunk_common/tasks/configure_server_cert.yml
review_question: Is this Ansible artifact overly complex because several size and dependency dimensions compound?
source_context:
1: ---
     2: # Configure Splunk server certificate from operator-mounted TLS secret.
     3: # Input: /mnt/tls/splunk-server-tls-cert/{tls.crt, tls.key[, ca.crt]}
     4: # Output: bundled PEM at /opt/splunk/etc/auth/splunk-server-bundle.pem
     5: #         CA at /opt/splunk/etc/auth/splunk-server-ca.pem
     6: #         server.conf [sslConfig] configured
     7: 
     8: - name: Generate ephemeral SSL passphrase
     9:   command: >
    10:     python3 -c
    11:     "import secrets, base64; print(base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(40)).decode())"
    12:   register: ssl_passphrase
    13:   changed_when: false
    14:   no_log: true
    15: 
    16: - name: Ensure Splunk auth directory exists
    17:   file:
    18:     path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth"
    19:     state: directory
    20:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    21:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
    22:     mode: '0700'
    23:   become: yes
    24:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    25: 
    26: - name: Write cert bundle script
    27:   copy:
    28:     dest: /tmp/splunk_bundle_cert.py
    29:     content: |
    30:       from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import (
    31:           load_pem_private_key, Encoding, PrivateFormat, BestAvailableEncryption
    32:       )
    33:       import sys
    34: 
    35:       passphrase = sys.argv[1].encode()
    36:       key_path   = '/mnt/tls/splunk-server-tls-cert/tls.key'
    37:       cert_path  = '/mnt/tls/splunk-server-tls-cert/tls.crt'
    38:       out_path   = sys.argv[2] + '/etc/auth/splunk-server-bundle.pem'
    39: 
    40:       with open(key_path, 'rb') as f:
    41:           key = load_pem_private_key(f.read(), password=None)
    42: 
    43:       enc_key_pem = key.private_bytes(
    44:           Encoding.PEM,
    45:           PrivateFormat.PKCS8,
    46:           BestAvailableEncryption(passphrase)
    47:       )
    48: 
    49:       with open(cert_path, 'rb') as f:
    50:           cert_pem = f.read()
    51: 
    52:       with open(out_path, 'wb') as f:
    53:           f.write(cert_pem)
    54:           if not cert_pem.endswith(b'\n'):
    55:               f.write(b'\n')
    56:           f.write(enc_key_pem)
    57:     mode: '0700'
    58: 
    59: - name: Encrypt private key and build server cert bundle
    60:   command: >
    61:     python3 /tmp/splunk_bundle_cert.py
    62:     {{ ssl_passphrase.stdout }} {{ splunk.home }}
    63:   become: yes
    64:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    65:   no_log: true
    66: 
    67: - name: Set bundle permissions
    68:   file:
    69:     path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/splunk-server-bundle.pem"
    70:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    71:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
    72:     mode: '0600'
    73:   become: yes
    74:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    75: 
    76: - name: Check if ca.crt is present in server cert mount
    77:   stat:
    78:     path: /mnt/tls/splunk-server-tls-cert/ca.crt
    79:   register: server_ca_file
    80: 
    81: - name: Set sslRootCAPath to system bundle when ca.crt is absent
    82:   set_fact:
    83:     server_ca_path: /etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/pem/tls-ca-bundle.pem
    84:   when: not server_ca_file.stat.exists
    85: 
    86: - name: Write CA trust bundle script
    87:   copy:
    88:     dest: /tmp/splunk_build_server_ca_bundle.py
    89:     content: |
    90:       # tls.crt from the operator-mounted secret may contain intermediate
    91:       # certs that are not repeated in ca.crt (e.g. Vault PKI issuers put
    92:       # only the root in ca.crt). Splunk requires the full chain to be
    93:       # present locally in sslRootCAPath -- it does not complete the chain
    94:       # using intermediates presented by the peer during the handshake.
    95:       # Assemble tls.crt's non-leaf certs + ca.crt into one deduplicated
    96:       # trust bundle.
    97:       import sys
    98: 
    99:       tls_crt_path = '/mnt/tls/splunk-server-tls-cert/tls.crt'
   100:       ca_crt_path = '/mnt/tls/splunk-server-tls-cert/ca.crt'
   101:       out_path = sys.argv[1] + '/etc/auth/splunk-server-ca.pem'
   102: 
   103:       def split_pem_certs(data):
   104:           certs = []
   105:           current = []
   106:           for line in data.splitlines(keepends=True):
   107:               if line.strip() == b'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----':
   108:                   current = [line]
   109:               elif line.strip() == b'-----END CERTIFICATE-----':
   110:                   current.append(line)
   111:                   certs.append(b''.join(current))
   112:                   current = []
   113:               elif current:
   114:                   current.append(line)
   115:           return certs
   116: 
   117:       with open(tls_crt_path, 'rb') as f:
   118:           tls_certs = split_pem_certs(f.read())
   119:       chain_certs = tls_certs[1:]  # drop the leaf; keep any presented intermediates/root
   120: 
   121:       with open(ca_crt_path, 'rb') as f:
   122:           ca_certs = split_pem_certs(f.read())
   123: 
   124:       seen = set()
   125:       ordered = []
   126:       for cert in chain_certs + ca_certs:
   127:           if cert not in seen:
   128:               seen.add(cert)
   129:               ordered.append(cert)
   130: 
   131:       with open(out_path, 'wb') as f:
   132:           for cert in ordered:
   133:               f.write(cert)
   134:               if not cert.endswith(b'\n'):
   135:                   f.write(b'\n')
   136:     mode: '0700'
   137:   when: server_ca_file.stat.exists
   138: 
   139: - name: Build server CA trust bundle
   140:   command: >
   141:     python3 /tmp/splunk_build_server_ca_bundle.py
   142:     {{ splunk.home }}
   143:   become: yes
   144:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   145:   changed_when: true
   146:   when: server_ca_file.stat.exists
   147: 
   148: - name: Set CA trust bundle permissions
   149:   file:
   150:     path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/splunk-server-ca.pem"
   151:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   152:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   153:     mode: '0644'
   154:   become: yes
   155:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   156:   when: server_ca_file.stat.exists
   157: 
   158: - name: Set sslRootCAPath to the assembled CA trust bundle
   159:   set_fact:
   160:     server_ca_path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/splunk-server-ca.pem"
   161:   when: server_ca_file.stat.exists
   162: 
   163: - name: Configure serverCert in server.conf
   164:   ini_file:
   165:     dest: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/system/local/server.conf"
   166:     section: sslConfig
   167:     option: serverCert
   168:     value: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/splunk-server-bundle.pem"
   169:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   170:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   171:   become: yes
   172:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   173: 
   174: - name: Configure sslPassword in server.conf
   175:   ini_file:
   176:     dest: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/system/local/server.conf"
   177:     section: sslConfig
   178:     option: sslPassword
   179:     value: "{{ ssl_passphrase.stdout }}"
   180:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   181:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   182:   become: yes
   183:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   184:   no_log: true
   185:   changed_when: false
   186: 
   187: - name: Configure sslRootCAPath in server.conf
   188:   ini_file:
   189:     dest: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/system/local/server.conf"
   190:     section: sslConfig
   191:     option: sslRootCAPath
   192:     value: "{{ server_ca_path }}"
   193:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   194:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   195:   become: yes
   196:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"

source_context:
1: ---
     2: - become: false

     4:   vars:
     5:     ansible_python_interpreter: "{{ ansible_playbook_python }}"
     6:     certificate_validity_days: 3650  # 10 years - configurable certificate lifespan
     7:   block:
     8:     - debug: var=subjectAltName
     9: 
    10:     - name: Ensure the pki directory does not exist
    11:       file:
    12:         dest: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}"
    13:         state: absent
    14:       when: keys_clean_all|bool
    15: 
    16:     - name: Ensure the pki directories exist
    17:       file:
    18:         dest: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/{{ item }}"
    19:         state: directory
    20:         recurse: true
    21:         mode: "0700"
    22:       loop:
    23:         - certs
    24:         - private
    25:         - public
    26: 
    27:     - name: Ensure the config directories exist
    28:       file:
    29:         dest: "{{ ipsec_config_path }}/{{ item }}"
    30:         state: directory
    31:         recurse: true
    32:         mode: "0700"
    33:       loop:
    34:         - apple
    35:         - manual
    36: 
    37:     - name: Create private key with password protection
    38:       community.crypto.openssl_privatekey:
    39:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/cakey.pem"
    40:         passphrase: "{{ CA_password }}"
    41:         type: ECC
    42:         curve: secp384r1
    43:         mode: "0600"
    44:       no_log: true
    45: 
    46:     # CA certificate with name constraints to prevent certificate misuse (Issue #75)
    47:     - name: Create certificate signing request (CSR) for CA certificate with security constraints
    48:       community.crypto.openssl_csr_pipe:
    49:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/cakey.pem"
    50:         privatekey_passphrase: "{{ CA_password }}"
    51:         common_name: "{{ IP_subject_alt_name }}"
    52:         use_common_name_for_san: true
    53:         # Generate Subject Key Identifier for proper Authority Key Identifier creation
    54:         create_subject_key_identifier: true
    55:         basic_constraints:
    56:           - 'CA:TRUE'
    57:           - 'pathlen:0'        # Prevents sub-CA creation - limits certificate chain depth if CA key compromised
    58:         basic_constraints_critical: true
    59:         key_usage:
    60:           - keyCertSign
    61:           - cRLSign
    62:         key_usage_critical: true
    63:         # CA restricted to VPN certificate issuance only
    64:         extended_key_usage:
    65:           - '1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.17'        # IPsec End Entity OID - VPN-specific usage
    66:         extended_key_usage_critical: true
    67:         # Name Constraints: Defense-in-depth security restricting certificate scope to prevent misuse
    68:         # Limits CA to only issue certificates for this specific VPN deployment's resources
    69:         # Per-deployment UUID prevents cross-deployment reuse, unique email domain isolates certificate scope
    70:         name_constraints_permitted: >-
    71:           {{ [
    72:             subjectAltName_type + ':' + IP_subject_alt_name + ('/255.255.255.255' if subjectAltName_type == 'IP' else ''),
    73:             'DNS:' + openssl_constraint_random_id,
    74:             'email:' + openssl_constraint_random_id
    75:           ] + (
    76:             ['IP:' + ansible_default_ipv6['address'] + '/128'] if ipv6_support | bool else []
    77:           ) }}
    78:         # Block public domains/networks to prevent certificate abuse for impersonation attacks
    79:         # Public TLD exclusion, Email domain exclusion, RFC 1918: prevents lateral movement
    80:         # IPv6: ULA/link-local/doc ranges or all
    81:         name_constraints_excluded: >-
    82:           {{ [
    83:             'DNS:.com', 'DNS:.org', 'DNS:.net', 'DNS:.gov', 'DNS:.edu', 'DNS:.mil', 'DNS:.int',
    84:             'email:.com', 'email:.org', 'email:.net', 'email:.gov', 'email:.edu', 'email:.mil', 'email:.int',
    85:             'IP:10.0.0.0/255.0.0.0', 'IP:172.16.0.0/255.240.0.0', 'IP:192.168.0.0/255.255.0.0'
    86:           ] + (
    87:             ['IP:fc00::/7', 'IP:fe80::/10', 'IP:2001:db8::/32'] if ipv6_support | bool else ['IP:::/0']
    88:           ) }}
    89:         name_constraints_critical: true
    90:       register: ca_csr
    91: 
    92:     - name: Create self-signed CA certificate from CSR
    93:       community.crypto.x509_certificate:
    94:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/cacert.pem"
    95:         csr_content: "{{ ca_csr.csr }}"
    96:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/cakey.pem"
    97:         privatekey_passphrase: "{{ CA_password }}"
    98:         provider: selfsigned
    99:         mode: "0644"
   100:       no_log: true
   101: 
   102:     - name: Copy the CA certificate
   103:       copy:
   104:         src: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/cacert.pem"
   105:         dest: "{{ ipsec_config_path }}/manual/cacert.pem"
   106:         mode: '0644'
   107: 
   108:     - name: Create private keys for users and server
   109:       community.crypto.openssl_privatekey:
   110:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}.key"
   111:         type: ECC
   112:         curve: secp384r1
   113:         mode: "0600"
   114:       loop: "{{ users + [IP_subject_alt_name] }}"
   115:       register: client_key_jobs
   116: 
   117:     # Server certificate with SAN extension - required for modern Apple devices
   118:     - name: Create CSRs for server certificate with SAN
   119:       community.crypto.openssl_csr_pipe:
   120:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ IP_subject_alt_name }}.key"
   121:         subject_alt_name: "{{ subjectAltName.split(',') }}"
   122:         common_name: "{{ IP_subject_alt_name }}"
   123:         # Add Basic Constraints to prevent certificate chain validation errors
   124:         basic_constraints:
   125:           - 'CA:FALSE'
   126:         basic_constraints_critical: false
   127:         key_usage:
   128:           - digitalSignature
   129:           - keyEncipherment
   130:         key_usage_critical: false
   131:         # Server auth EKU required for IKEv2 server certificates (Issue #75)
   132:         # NOTE: clientAuth deliberately excluded to prevent role confusion attacks
   133:         extended_key_usage:
   134:           - serverAuth                    # Server Authentication (RFC 5280)
   135:           - '1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.17'        # IPsec End Entity (RFC 4945)
   136:         extended_key_usage_critical: false
   137:       register: server_csr
   138: 
   139:     - name: Create CSRs for client certificates
   140:       community.crypto.openssl_csr_pipe:
   141:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}.key"
   142:         subject_alt_name:
   143:           - "email:{{ item }}@{{ openssl_constraint_random_id }}"  # UUID domain prevents certificate reuse across deployments
   144:         common_name: "{{ item }}"
   145:         # Add Basic Constraints to client certificates for proper PKI validation
   146:         basic_constraints:
   147:           - 'CA:FALSE'
   148:         basic_constraints_critical: false
   149:         key_usage:
   150:           - digitalSignature
   151:           - keyEncipherment
   152:         key_usage_critical: false
   153:         # Client certs restricted to clientAuth only - prevents clients from impersonating the VPN server
   154:         # NOTE: serverAuth deliberately excluded to prevent server impersonation attacks
   155:         extended_key_usage:
   156:           - clientAuth                    # Client Authentication (RFC 5280)
   157:           - '1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.17'        # IPsec End Entity (RFC 4945)
   158:         extended_key_usage_critical: false
   159:       loop: "{{ users }}"
   160:       register: client_csr_jobs
   161: 
   162:     - name: Sign server certificate with CA
   163:       community.crypto.x509_certificate:
   164:         csr_content: "{{ server_csr.csr }}"
   165:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/certs/{{ IP_subject_alt_name }}.crt"
   166:         provider: ownca
   167:         ownca_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/cacert.pem"
   168:         ownca_privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/cakey.pem"
   169:         ownca_privatekey_passphrase: "{{ CA_password }}"
   170:         ownca_not_after: "+{{ certificate_validity_days }}d"
   171:         ownca_not_before: "-1d"
   172:         mode: "0644"
   173:       no_log: true
   174: 
   175:     - name: Sign client certificates with CA
   176:       community.crypto.x509_certificate:
   177:         csr_content: "{{ item.csr }}"
   178:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/certs/{{ item.item }}.crt"
   179:         provider: ownca
   180:         ownca_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/cacert.pem"
   181:         ownca_privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/cakey.pem"
   182:         ownca_privatekey_passphrase: "{{ CA_password }}"
   183:         ownca_not_after: "+{{ certificate_validity_days }}d"
   184:         ownca_not_before: "-1d"
   185:         mode: "0644"
   186:       loop: "{{ client_csr_jobs.results }}"
   187:       register: client_sign_results
   188:       no_log: true
   189: 
   190:     - name: Generate p12 files
   191:       community.crypto.openssl_pkcs12:
   192:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}.p12"
   193:         friendly_name: "{{ item }}"
   194:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}.key"
   195:         certificate_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/certs/{{ item }}.crt"
   196:         passphrase: "{{ p12_export_password }}"
   197:         mode: "0600"
   198:         encryption_level: "compatibility2022"  # Apple device compatibility
   199:       loop: "{{ users }}"
   200:       no_log: true
   201: 
   202:     - name: Generate p12 files with CA certificate included
   203:       community.crypto.openssl_pkcs12:
   204:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}_ca.p12"
   205:         friendly_name: "{{ item }}"
   206:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}.key"
   207:         certificate_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/certs/{{ item }}.crt"
   208:         other_certificates:
   209:           - "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/cacert.pem"
   210:         passphrase: "{{ p12_export_password }}"
   211:         mode: "0600"
   212:         encryption_level: "compatibility2022"  # Apple device compatibility
   213:       loop: "{{ users }}"
   214:       no_log: true
   215: 
   216:     - name: Copy the p12 certificates
   217:       copy:
   218:         src: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}.p12"
   219:         dest: "{{ ipsec_config_path }}/manual/{{ item }}.p12"
   220:         mode: '0600'
   221:       loop: "{{ users }}"
   222: 
   223:     - name: Build openssh public keys
   224:       community.crypto.openssl_publickey:
   225:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/public/{{ item }}.pub"
   226:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/{{ item }}.key"
   227:         format: OpenSSH
   228:       loop: "{{ users }}"
   229: 
   230:     - name: Add all users to the file
   231:       ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
   232:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/all-users"
   233:         line: "{{ item }}"
   234:         mode: '0644'
   235:         create: true
   236:       loop: "{{ users }}"
   237:       register: users_file
   238: 
   239:     - name: Set all users as a fact
   240:       set_fact:
   241:         all_users: "{{ lookup('file', ipsec_pki_path + '/all-users').splitlines() }}"
   242: 
   243:     # Certificate Revocation List (CRL) for removed users
   244:     - name: Calculate current timestamp for CRL
   245:       set_fact:
   246:         crl_timestamp: "{{ '%Y%m%d%H%M%SZ' | strftime(ansible_date_time.epoch | int) }}"
   247: 
   248:     - name: Identify users whose certificates need revocation
   249:       set_fact:
   250:         users_to_revoke: "{{ all_users | difference(users) }}"
   251: 
   252:     - name: Build revoked certificates list
   253:       set_fact:
   254:         revoked_certificates: >-
   255:           {{ users_to_revoke | map('regex_replace', '^(.*)$',
   256:              '{"path": "' + ipsec_pki_path + '/certs/\1.crt", "revocation_date": "' + crl_timestamp + '"}') | list }}
   257: 
   258:     - name: Generate a CRL
   259:       community.crypto.x509_crl:
   260:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/crl.pem"
   261:         privatekey_path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/private/cakey.pem"
   262:         privatekey_passphrase: "{{ CA_password }}"
   263:         last_update: "{{ '%Y%m%d%H%M%SZ' | strftime(ansible_date_time.epoch | int) }}"

   268:         revoked_certificates: "{{ revoked_certificates }}"
   269:       no_log: true

   271:     - name: Set CRL file permissions

   273:         path: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/crl.pem"
   274:         mode: "0644"
   275: 
   276: - name: Copy the CRL to the vpn server
   277:   copy:
   278:     src: "{{ ipsec_pki_path }}/crl.pem"
   279:     dest: "{{ config_prefix | default('/') }}etc/ipsec.d/crls/algo.root.pem"
   280:     mode: '0644'
   281:   notify:

source_context:
1: ---
     2: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://taskfile.dev/schema.json
     3: version: "3"
     4: 
     5: # Taskfile used to manage certain VolSync tasks for a given application, limitations are as followed.
     6: #   1. Fluxtomization, HelmRelease, PVC, ReplicationSource all have the same name (e.g. plex)
     7: #   2. ReplicationSource and ReplicationDestination are a Restic repository
     8: #   3. Each application only has one PVC that is being replicated
     9: 
    10: vars:
    11:   VOLSYNC_RESOURCES_DIR: "{{.ROOT_DIR}}/.taskfiles/VolSync/resources"
    12: 
    13: tasks:
    14:   state-*:
    15:     desc: Suspend or resume Volsync
    16:     cmds:
    17:       - flux --namespace volsync-system {{.STATE}} kustomization volsync
    18:       - flux --namespace volsync-system {{.STATE}} helmrelease volsync
    19:       - kubectl --namespace volsync-system scale deployment volsync --replicas {{if eq .STATE "suspend"}}0{{else}}1{{end}}
    20:     vars:
    21:       STATE: "{{index .MATCH 0}}"
    22:     preconditions:
    23:       - '[[ "{{.STATE}}" == "suspend" || "{{.STATE}}" == "resume" ]]'
    24:       - which flux kubectl
    25: 
    26:   unlock:
    27:     desc: Unlock all restic source repos
    28:     cmds:
    29:       - for: { var: SOURCES, split: "\n" }
    30:         cmd: kubectl --namespace {{splitList "," .ITEM | first}} patch --field-manager=flux-client-side-apply replicationsources {{splitList "," .ITEM | last}} --type merge --patch "{\"spec\":{\"restic\":{\"unlock\":\"{{now | unixEpoch}}\"}}}"
    31:     vars:
    32:       SOURCES:
    33:         sh: kubectl get replicationsources --all-namespaces --no-headers --output=jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace},{.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}'
    34:     preconditions:
    35:       - which kubectl
    36: 
    37:   snapshot:
    38:     desc: Snapshot an app [NS=default] [APP=required]
    39:     cmds:
    40:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} patch replicationsources {{.APP}} --type merge -p '{"spec":{"trigger":{"manual":"{{now | unixEpoch}}"}}}'
    41:       - until kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get job/{{.JOB}} &>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done
    42:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} wait job/{{.JOB}} --for=condition=complete --timeout=120m
    43:     vars:
    44:       NS: '{{.NS | default "default"}}'
    45:       JOB: volsync-src-{{.APP}}
    46:     requires:
    47:       vars: [APP]
    48:     preconditions:
    49:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get replicationsources {{.APP}}
    50:       - which kubectl
    51: 
    52:   restore:
    53:     desc: Restore an app [NS=default] [APP=required] [PREVIOUS=required]
    54:     cmds:
    55:       # Suspend
    56:       - flux --namespace {{.NS}} suspend kustomization {{.APP}}
    57:       - flux --namespace {{.NS}} suspend helmrelease {{.APP}}
    58:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} scale {{.CONTROLLER}}/{{.APP}} --replicas 0
    59:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} wait pod --for=delete --selector="app.kubernetes.io/name={{.APP}}" --timeout=5m
    60:       # Restore
    61:       - minijinja-cli {{.VOLSYNC_RESOURCES_DIR}}/replicationdestination.yaml.j2 | kubectl apply --server-side --filename -
    62:       - until kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get job/volsync-dst-{{.APP}}-manual &>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done
    63:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} wait job/volsync-dst-{{.APP}}-manual --for=condition=complete --timeout=120m
    64:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} delete replicationdestination {{.APP}}-manual
    65:       # Resume
    66:       - flux --namespace {{.NS}} resume kustomization {{.APP}}
    67:       - flux --namespace {{.NS}} resume helmrelease {{.APP}}
    68:       - flux --namespace {{.NS}} reconcile helmrelease {{.APP}} --force
    69:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} wait pod --for=condition=ready --selector="app.kubernetes.io/name={{.APP}}" --timeout=5m
    70:     vars:
    71:       NS: '{{.NS | default "default"}}'
    72:       CONTROLLER:
    73:         sh: kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get deployment {{.APP}} &>/dev/null && echo deployment || echo statefulset
    74:     env:
    75:       NS: "{{.NS}}"
    76:       APP: "{{.APP}}"
    77:       PREVIOUS: "{{.PREVIOUS}}"
    78:       CLAIM:
    79:         sh: kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get replicationsources/{{.APP}} --output=jsonpath='{.spec.sourcePVC}'
    80:       ACCESS_MODES:
    81:         sh: kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get replicationsources/{{.APP}} --output=jsonpath='{.spec.restic.accessModes}'
    82:       STORAGE_CLASS_NAME:
    83:         sh: kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get replicationsources/{{.APP}} --output=jsonpath='{.spec.restic.storageClassName}'
    84:       PUID:
    85:         sh: kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get replicationsources/{{.APP}} --output=jsonpath='{.spec.restic.moverSecurityContext.runAsUser}'
    86:       PGID:
    87:         sh: kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get replicationsources/{{.APP}} --output=jsonpath='{.spec.restic.moverSecurityContext.runAsGroup}'
    88:     requires:
    89:       vars: [APP, PREVIOUS]
    90:     preconditions:
    91:       - test -f {{.VOLSYNC_RESOURCES_DIR}}/replicationdestination.yaml.j2
    92:       - which flux kubectl minijinja-cli
    93: 
    94:   unlock-local:
    95:     desc: Unlock a restic source repo from local machine [NS=default] [APP=required]
    96:     cmds:
    97:       - minijinja-cli {{.VOLSYNC_RESOURCES_DIR}}/unlock.yaml.j2 | kubectl apply --server-side --filename -
    98:       - until kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} get job/volsync-unlock-{{.APP}} &>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done
    99:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} wait job/volsync-unlock-{{.APP}} --for condition=complete --timeout=5m
   100:       - stern --namespace {{.NS}} job/volsync-unlock-{{.APP}} --no-follow
   101:       - kubectl --namespace {{.NS}} delete job volsync-unlock-{{.APP}}
   102:     vars:
   103:       NS: '{{.NS | default "default"}}'
   104:     env:
   105:       NS: "{{.NS}}"
   106:       APP: "{{.APP}}"
   107:     requires:
   108:       vars: [APP]
   109:     preconditions:
   110:       - test -f {{.VOLSYNC_RESOURCES_DIR}}/unlock.yaml.j2
   111:       - which kubectl minijinja-cli stern
